purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Bihar's official BhuNaksha public viewer was followed through its current JavaScript to live REST endpoints. Motihari Sadar/Motihari/मोतिहारी(122) administrative data and EPSG:32645 cadastral sheet extents were verified. Anonymous point probes returned two opaque parcel ids, but no safe polygon geometry or stable native schema was exposed; no GeoJSON sample was retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: Local custody is evidenced by the official East Champaran district land-record page naming the Motihari land-record office, while the Bihar Department of Revenue and Land Reforms/BhuNaksha portal provides state cadastral map custody. These establish relevant registry custody but not an open parcel-vector integration.

attempts.result: HTTP 200 public viewer and assets retrieved; REST/WMS paths identified; no authentication used.
Public POSTs returned 7 levels and Motihari path 02/01/01/0009; Cadastral Survey map 06 sheets 01 and 02 were listed.
Public POSTs returned EPSG:32645 extents and gisCodes CS02010100091220601/602.
getPlotAtXY returned id+kide pairs for two interior test points; no geometry or attributes_json was returned. Exact WUP point was not treated as a coverage absence.
Direct GET attempt returned generic 404 error page; no unsafe fields requested.

geometryDecision.details: No full parcel polygon was obtained. Two bounded point responses contained opaque ids only; no GeoJSON was retained.
